name: Daily Easy Apply Digest
tagline: A morning shortlist of backend roles you can apply to in one click, ranked against your CV
description: Two job boards, hundreds of postings, and most of them wrong for you. Each morning this gathers the mid-level backend openings that take a one-click application, reads every one of them against your own resume, and ranks them by how well they genuinely fit. The day starts with a shortlist, not a search.
author: HaseebMir91
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
